review.title: Neoadjuvant Chemoimmunotherapy for NSCLC: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

criteria.text: Only studies with adult patients were included.
criteria.note: No age threshold is specified; 'adult' needs an operational definition (e.g., >=18 years).

criteria.text: Patients with resectable lung cancer / resectable NSCLC.
criteria.note: 'Resectable' is not operationalized; it depends on stage, surgical assessment, and local practice.

criteria.text: Studies that did not use TNM staging were excluded.
criteria.note: TNM version and the minimum staging information required are not specified.

criteria.text: Studies that included only patients with NSCLC with EGFR variants were excluded.
criteria.note: The scope of 'EGFR variants' is not specified (any EGFR alteration vs. sensitizing mutations only).
The composition of 'chemoimmunotherapy' (drug classes, cycles, sequencing) is not defined.
Usually identifiable from the regimen name; platinum agent may vary.
Study design is often stated in the abstract, but not always; full text may be needed.
Requires a clear operational definition of observational design.
Requires a clear operational definition of retrospective design.

criteria.text: Published articles reporting trial-level data related to neoadjuvant chemotherapy or neoadjuvant chemoimmunotherapy.
criteria.note: 'Trial-level data' is not defined; it may exclude pooled analyses, subgroup reports, and some follow-up publications.

criteria.text: Abstracts, conference proceedings, retrospective studies, editorials, comments, gray literature, and all other publication types without trial-level evidence were excluded.
criteria.note: The scope of 'without trial-level evidence' is ambiguous; the review later included 6 conference abstracts with trial-level data.

criteria.text: Editorials, comments, and gray literature were excluded.
criteria.note: Publication type is usually visible from the record metadata.

criteria.text: Trials reporting the use of neoadjuvant radiotherapy, including chemoradiotherapy, were excluded.
criteria.note: Usually identifiable from the regimen name.

criteria.text: Trials reporting the use of molecular targeted therapy were excluded.
criteria.note: Usually identifiable from the drug name.

criteria.text: Trials reporting the use of immunotherapy monotherapy were excluded.
criteria.note: Distinguishing monotherapy from combination therapy requires regimen details; abstracts may not report them.
Language is a metadata field; no semantic judgment needed.

criteria.text: Studies published from 2013 onward; search last updated October 25, 2023.
criteria.note: Publication date is a metadata field; the search end date is a separate temporal boundary.

pico_notes.comparator: Chemotherapy is specified as the comparator for comparative analyses; single-arm trials are eligible without a comparator, so a comparator is not a universal eligibility condition.
pico_notes.outcome: No outcome restriction is stated; outcomes are defined by the analysis rather than by eligibility.

workflow.exclusion_reason_note: The main text reports the number excluded at full text but does not list reasons; PRISMA 2020 requires reasons for exclusion.
